summary: The paper describes the Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) of intermetallic Co3Sn2 and Ni3Sn2 thin films using diamine adducts of cobalt(II) and nickel(II) chlorides combined with tributyltin hydride (TBTH) at low temperatures below 200 °C. The films were characterized for their uniformity, crystallinity, and purity, showing high crystallinity and minimal impurities. The Co3Sn2 films exhibited magnetic hysteresis with high coercivity values, indicating potential applications in magnetic devices.
